title: Underived integral direct-image exchange
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. Let $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ form a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], and assume f is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. The canonical exchange transformation [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] $g^*f_*\to f'_*g'^*$ on sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0EYP (integral direct-image base change); strict-henselian proof via Tags 03Q9, 09XK, 09ZH and 0A3I

proof.text: By stability of integral morphisms under base change (Stacks Tag 01WK; Mathlib IsIntegralHom stability), infer IsIntegralHom f' with MorphismProperty.of_isPullback. Fix a sheaf F and a residue-field algebraic-closure point s of Y'. Form its pullback square sq2 for f', and paste with the given square to obtain sq3 for f over s followed by g. Apply [lem-sbc-integral-geometric-point-exchange] to sq2 and sq3.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-underived-horizontal-pasting] on F. The outer exchange equals the composite of the source composition isomorphism, s^* of the desired exchange, the inner exchange, and the pushforward of the target composition isomorphism. Since both geometric-point exchanges and both composition maps are isomorphisms, cancel them with isIso_comp_left_iff and isIso_comp_right_iff to prove that s^* of the desired exchange is invertible.

The lifted inverse-image stalk isomorphism [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar], applied to s and the identity point of Spec Omega, identifies the original stalk at s with the identity-point stalk of this pullback. Naturality and preservation of isomorphisms give invertibility of the original stalk. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] for every point, then NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app for every sheaf F, obtaining invertibility of the entire exchange natural transformation.
